F01_architecture.caption: HoloEnergy closed loop: controller wrench -> allocation over the configured actuator layout -> electrical models -> bus -> battery -> available power/derating -> applied forces -> HoloOcean dynamics; DESERT activity is observed, never driven.

F02_evidence_flow.caption: Evidence and provenance flow; grade coverage is provenance, not a confidence interval.

F03_t200_model.caption: T200 electrical model = Blue Robotics static (bollard) force/power tables, interpolated; points are table entries. No published advance-speed data: inflow effects are not modelled.

F04_backend_verification.caption: Implementation verification at 100 Hz: the official binary and its unpatched control rebuild apply 0.01x the SI drag; the patched build applies 1.000000x. Verification of the drag equation, not validation of BlueROV2 hydrodynamics.

F06_layouts_station_keeping.caption: Native closed-loop station keeping on the BlueROV2 body (L8-HV simulator-exact; others virtual layouts via wrench-equivalent actuation; separate y-scales). Hatched 'not met': requested wrench not achieved (allocation residual or native clamp) - not comparable.

F07_orientation_tradeoff.caption: Horizontal thruster angle trades surge against sway cost (0.5 m/s current, native closed loop).

F08_station_keeping_current.caption: Station keeping: speed-only baselines fitted on the calm-water transit cannot see current-induced effort.

F09_payload_breakdown.caption: Mission energy by category for three sensor/compute suites (same native transit).

F10_communication_policies.caption: Native DESERT: communication energy of identical traffic under different network strategies (labels: delivered/generated). LISTEN dominates.

F11_mission_with_without_comms.caption: Same native mission with different network strategies: communication energy enters the battery through the observe-only adapter.

F13_uncertainty_intervals.caption: Interval propagation of published component ranges; sides without published bounds stay open.
